system.description:
You have worked hard to eliminate your behavioral tells, making it almost impossible to discern when you are lying.

Prerequisite: Twi'lek

Effect: Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to a Deception check, increase the die type by two steps (From d6 to d10, or from d8 to d12).

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
